findings.text: bats_execute now runs the command with PATH="$BATS_SAVED_PATH" in place of the old BATS_PATH. I found no definition of BATS_SAVED_PATH in this change (only the patch is available), so if any caller or subshell doesn't export it, PATH expands to empty and `bats_execute sort`, `bats_execute date` and similar fail with 'command not found'. The empty PATH also drops the saved-path protection against test PATH mocks. This fails only if the rename wasn't applied everywhere BATS_PATH was set.
